Answer: B
Reason: The CT images (specifically Figure 2a and 2b) demonstrate predominant micronodular lesions and consolidation in the right upper and middle lobes, along with a distinct fibrotic focus in the left upper lobe. This asymmetric distribution with an apical fibrotic scar is characteristic of reactivation pulmonary tuberculosis rather than the uniform random distribution of classic miliary TB or other patterns listed.
